name: Disneyland The Tropical Hideaway Steamed Pork & Lemongrass Bao Bun
whyItWorks: Soft, pillowy steamed yeast dough filled with savory minced pork, sweet soy, and a hint of lemongrass. Steamed buns are low-fat and easy to chew.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Steamed Pork Bao Bun; enjoy with mild soy dipping sauce (avoid spicy chili garlic sauce).
